purpose: Test the most direct surviving exterior shortcut: whether each coherent variable factor A_i+B_i can be made into one decomposable blade by an invertible change of basis, so that the whole top coefficient would collapse toward one determinant/Slater/Pfaffian object.

source_geometry.vectors: For an occurrence group G of size d, a_o=[0|e_o] and b_o=[-v_o|e_o].
source_geometry.independence: Distinct occurrences have distinct clause-gadget coordinate vectors v_o, hence {v_o:o in G} is linearly independent. Therefore U=span{a_o} and W=span{b_o} both have dimension d and U intersection W={0}.
source_geometry.factor: A=wedge_o a_o, B=wedge_o b_o, Omega=A+B in Lambda^d(U direct_sum W).

theorem.name: SOURCE_COHERENT_TWO_BLADE_FACTOR_IS_NOT_DECOMPOSABLE_FOR_D_GE_2
theorem.statement: Over every field, for d>=2 and U,W transverse d-spaces, a nonzero form Omega=A+B formed from their top blades is not decomposable. Hence no invertible linear change of the ambient one-particle basis can turn Omega into a single d-blade.
proof: Take x=u+w in U direct_sum W. Since A is the top blade of U and B the top blade of W, u wedge A=0 and w wedge B=0.
Thus x wedge Omega = u wedge B + w wedge A.
The first term has bidegree (1,d) and the second has bidegree (d,1) in Lambda(U direct_sum W). For d>=2 these bidegrees are distinct, so cancellation between them is impossible.
Because U and W are transverse and A,B are nonzero top blades, u wedge B=0 implies u=0 and w wedge A=0 implies w=0. Hence the wedge-annihilator {x in U+W:x wedge Omega=0} is {0}.
A nonzero decomposable d-blade z_1 wedge ... wedge z_d has wedge-annihilator equal to span(z_1,...,z_d), of dimension d. Contradiction.
Decomposability is invariant under invertible linear changes of basis, so no ordinary basis transform repairs the factor.

killed: Replace every degree-2/3 coherent variable factor A_i+B_i by one blade in the same exterior space
Any invertible ordinary basis transform claimed to make all such factors single Slater determinants
A direct one-determinant contraction whose only missing step is local decomposability of A_i+B_i
not_killed: Polynomially many auxiliary dimensions plus nontrivial projection/contraction
Global cancellation coupling several variable factors at once

literature_boundary.generic_higher_order: Ikenmeyer-Walter prove the generic hyperpfaffian VNP-complete; therefore generic higher-order Pfaffian evaluation is not a licensed polynomial subroutine.
literature_boundary.generic_mixed_low_rank: Gurvits proves exact mixed discriminant computation #P-hard even for rank-2 positive semidefinite matrices. Low local tensor/matrix rank alone therefore does not imply a polynomial exact contraction.
